dedupe_keys.name: robine at austrian hourly electricity demand and supply profiles

description: The ROBINE-AT energy team publishes hourly Austrian electricity demand and supply profiles at NUTS-3 regional scale. The Zenodo description lists historical 1991–2010 conditions and three 20-year periods representing global warming levels of 2, 3 and 4 degrees. Four ZIP packages separate these settings. Supply variables include wind, photovoltaic and run-of-river hydro; demand includes weather-dependent and other components by use. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. These time series can drive regional capacity and climate-stress simulations, after connecting regions and network assets in a model such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that warming-level periods come from selected climate runs and are not a single time-continuous forecast. Normalized load components must be scaled and aligned before aggregate demand is inferred. Own metadata and the file manifest were read without downloading profiles or checking all column units. The ROBINE hazard-indicator maps are a separate deposit.
